stem.text: Forces are applied to a rigid object. The forces all act in the same plane.
In which diagram is the object in equilibrium?

A.alt: Rectangle with forces drawn as arrows labelled ½F and F acting on it.

B.alt: Rectangle with forces drawn as arrows labelled F and ½F acting on it.

C.alt: Rectangle with forces drawn as arrows labelled F acting on it.

D.alt: Rectangle with forces drawn as arrows labelled ½F acting on it.
